result.stdout:
Description:
  Tonarink standalone CLI: manage an independent background LocalSend service

Usage:
  tonarink-cli [command] [options]

Options:
  --json                 Write progress and results as NDJSON
  --timeout <timeout>    Cancel this command after N seconds (1-86400)
  --no-start             Only connect to an already running host
  --language <language>  CLI output language: system, zh-CN or en-US (default: system)
  --profile <profile>    Independent configuration/data directory
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  --version              Show version information

Commands:
  status                Show server state without starting the host
  devices               List known devices
  discover              Refresh discovery and list nearby devices
  send <paths>          Send files, folders or text to a device
  cancel <transfer-id>  Cancel a pending or active transfer
  receive               Inspect and handle incoming requests
  server                Control the LocalSend server
  settings              Read or persist host settings
  favorites             Manage saved device identities
  history               Manage receive history without deleting saved files
  web                   Manage browser sharing
  app                   Control the independent CLI host
